title: ENGRAVED PET COLLARS
description: Companions now keep nicknames, adoption dates, favorite snacks, and a little collar plate that can be upgraded with premium metals and tiny heroic fonts.
consequence: The pet gets a nameplate with a receipt.

title: EARNED GUILD BANNERS
description: Guild halls now unlock banners through shared milestones, raid memories, and member signatures instead of selling crest packs from the hall vendor.
consequence: The banner learns who carried it.

title: SEASONAL COMPANION RENTALS
description: The stable now offers limited-time companion leases with themed animations, premium saddle slots, and a cheerful return date printed beside the friendship meter.
consequence: The stable starts measuring affection in weekends.

title: STANDARDIZED MEMORY ALBUM
description: Player albums now compress old screenshots, gifts, camp notes, and named discoveries into tidy account-safe scrapbook stickers for faster profile loading.
consequence: The scrapbook forgets which hands made it.
